giver: Growers' co-operative: farmer representatives in every village; the co-op's leader in Reece for key moments
feel: The Harvest Festival building up over the seasons: spring planting, a hard winter, prize crops and festival night

quests.title: A Share in the Co-op
quests.summary: A village farmer offers you a share in the Growers' Co-operative: till a plot, plant wheat and bring in your first 64 wheat. This year, he says, the co-op means to hold a proper Harvest Festival again.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a stone hoe and seed bags

quests.title: Scarecrow and Compost
quests.summary: Protect the plot: build a scarecrow (Farm & Charm), fill a composter, and craft fertilizer for the next planting.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a pitchfork

quests.title: Seeds from the Wild
quests.summary: The co-op wants new crops for the festival: find wild tomatoes, wild lettuce, wild onions and wild oats (Farm & Charm) and wild cabbages (Farmer's Delight), and gather their seeds.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a crafting bowl and a bag of mixed seeds

quests.title: A Farmer Who Thinks
quests.summary: The village farmer replants with whatever seeds he's given (Smarter Farmers). Fence and water a new village field, hand him carrots, potatoes and beetroot, and watch him keep it planted for the co-op.
quests.reward: Farming XP, an iron hoe

quests.title: Spring Planting
quests.summary: The festival is announced for the autumn and the co-op's spring planting begins: grow and harvest tomatoes, lettuce, strawberries and onions (Farm & Charm).
quests.reward: Farming XP, a festival bunting banner

quests.title: Barn Raising
quests.summary: Visit an old barn or wheat farm out in the country to see how it's done, then raise a barn of your own with a feeding trough, a chicken coop and a hay loft of straw bales.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a supply cart (Farm & Charm)

quests.title: Rich Soil
quests.summary: Make organic compost (Farmer's Delight) from straw, rotten flesh and bone meal and let it turn to rich soil; grow brown and red mushroom colonies on it for the co-op's kitchen garden.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a water sprinkler (Farm & Charm)

quests.title: Rice Paddies
quests.summary: The festival needs rice: find wild rice in a river and grow a paddy of it (Farmer's Delight) in shallow water; bring in a rice bale.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a canvas rug

quests.title: The Cheese Wheel
quests.summary: The co-op's cheesemaker wants your milk: milk a wooly cow or a water buffalo with a wooden bucket (Meadow), and turn it into a cheese block in a cheese form.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a cheese rack

quests.title: Corn Rows
quests.summary: Plant long rows of corn (Farm & Charm), harvest them and dry kernels into popcorn (Corn Expansion) to sell at the festival stall.
quests.reward: Farming XP, popcorn tins

quests.title: The Vineyard
quests.summary: Start the co-op's vineyard: collect red and white grape seeds plus one savanna, taiga or jungle variety (Vinery) and grow them on lattices.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a winemaker's apron

quests.title: The Festival Toast
quests.summary: Press grapes in an apple press and ferment them in a fermentation barrel (Vinery) to have red wine and apple cider ready for the festival toast.
quests.reward: Farming XP, wine racks

quests.title: Shearing Day
quests.summary: Shearing day at the co-op: shear wooly sheep and horned sheep (Meadow) and bring in 32 wool before noon for the festival's flecked and highland wool bunting.
quests.reward: Farming XP, highland wool and a pair of shears

quests.title: The Orchard
quests.summary: Plant the co-op an orchard: apple saplings (Vinery) and cherries, plus a flowering oak from a Biomes O' Plenty orchard; harvest a bag of apples and press apple juice.
quests.reward: Farming XP, an apple bag and applesauce

quests.title: The Wandering Winemaker
quests.summary: A wandering winemaker (Vinery) passes through the co-op's fields and tastes your wine; trade him for cherry saplings and his advice on ageing.
quests.reward: Farming XP, cherry and apple saplings

quests.title: The Field That Won't Grow
quests.summary: Old Farmer Hobb's field has stood bare for years. Find out why, then restore it: drain the waterlogged corner, lay rich soil, set water sprinklers, bone meal the rows and replant until it bears again. He gives you his old boots.
quests.reward: Farming XP, Rooted Boots

quests.title: The Silo
quests.summary: Build the co-op a silo (Farm & Charm) and fill it with barley and oats to dry for the winter and for the brewers.
quests.reward: Farming XP, flour and yeast

quests.title: Crows at the Outpost
quests.summary: A farmer outpost far from the village is losing its crop: deliver seed corn and a scarecrow, and defend the field through the night from the mobs trampling it.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a chicken nest and a coop of hens

quests.title: The Livestock Fair
quests.summary: The festival's livestock fair: breed cows, sheep, pigs, chickens and a water buffalo (Meadow) and show your best pair of each.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a feeding trough and a rosette

quests.title: The Giant Pumpkin
quests.summary: The pumpkin contest: grow pumpkins in a pumpkin patch (Biomes O' Plenty) or your own field and bring the co-op a full stack in one harvest.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a stuffed pumpkin recipe

quests.title: Bees and Mead
quests.summary: Keep a hive near the flower fields, harvest honey bottles and honeycomb with a campfire beneath, and ferment mead (Vinery) for the festival.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a beehive and a mead barrel

quests.title: The Hard Winter
quests.summary: A snowy village's harvest failed and they won't see spring without help. Before the winter's end (in-game days), deliver 64 bread, 16 potato soup and 16 barley soup (Farm & Charm) and seed for next year.
quests.reward: Farming XP, the snowy village's festival pledge

quests.title: Grapes in the Nether
quests.summary: The winemaker swears grapes grow in the Nether: find crimson and warped grape seeds (Nether Vinery) and grow them; then visit the old nether wart plantation for its wart.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a crimson fermentation barrel

quests.title: Ice Wine
quests.summary: Make the rarest wine for the festival's top table: grow taiga grapes in the cold, and age eiswein and a cherry wine (Vinery) in the cellar.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a big bottle of eiswein

quests.title: Prize Crops
quests.summary: The festival's prize table: a crate of every crop the co-op grows, from Farmer's Delight cabbages and rice to Farm & Charm barley and strawberries, corn, grapes and Nether grapes.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a silo of your own

quests.title: The Market Stall
quests.summary: Festival market day: run the co-op's stall against the other villages' farmers, selling your best produce to villagers for emeralds; outsell them all and win the market master's hat.
quests.reward: Farming XP, Villager Hat

quests.title: The Festival Grounds
quests.summary: Build the Harvest Festival grounds in Reece: a long table, bunting, hay bales, a stage for the band and the prize table under a barn roof.
quests.reward: Farming XP, the festival's banner

quests.title: The Harvest Festival
quests.summary: Festival night: bring the feast's produce, the wine and the cheese, and the co-op's leader opens the Harvest Festival in Reece with every village you fed in the hard winter.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a festival crown (straw hat)

quests.title: Harvest Moon
quests.summary: The co-op's leader names you Master Grower and gives you the hoe that cut the first sheaf.
quests.reward: Farming XP, Harvest Moon (named netherite hoe: Fortune III, Efficiency V, Unbreaking III, Mending)
